summary: CR-385 Phase 0.5 QA RE-TEST ROUND 2 (frontend-only @1920x800) against preprod via /pms/front-desk-v2. Independent Playwright script re-ran the two Round-1 FAIL/BLOCKED cases (RT-1 BUG-435 Case C focus-after-idle, RT-2 BUG-434 recovery), the Round-1 BLOCKED Rooms retry (RT-3), the coalescing regression (RT-4 BUG-435 Case B), and a compact regression subset (REG-1). Result: 4/4 RT cases PASS; REG-1 mostly PASS but surfaces a duplicate-data-testid violation on Arrivals when a row expansion is open (fd-row-17-checkin-btn and fd-row-17-kebab). Zero unexpected non-ignored console errors: the 4 'Failed to load resource: 500' entries are emitted by the intentional page.route() intercepts of aiosell/local-reservations and aiosell/room-status-board (2 each) and are expected per spec. Full request timeline captured; preprod was healthy (LR 200 in ~1.1 s for the RT-2 recovery request).

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid values on the Arrivals tab when a row is expanded: 'fd-row-17-checkin-btn' and 'fd-row-17-kebab' appear TWICE in the DOM (once in the collapsed row and once in the expansion drawer). All other tabs and Rooms-with-RoomDetail-open remain clean.

Immediately after that new batch, second focus within 2 s → delta local-reservations=0 (debounced as expected).

cases_pass_fail.RT-4_BUG-435_caseB_coalesce_two_clicks: PASS — two fd-refresh-btn clicks 50 ms apart produced exactly 1 new local-reservations request.

cases_pass_fail.REG-1_tile_counts: PASS — fd-tab-arrivals-count=0, fd-tab-departures-count=2, fd-tab-inhouse-count=2 (all match iteration_8 sandbox truth; live LR JSON was not re-fetched but tiles were rendered from the batch responses).

request_timeline_evidence.RT-1: click t=15.21s → batch complete t=16.42s (batch latency ~1.2s); idle 7.00s; focus t=23.42s → +1 LR/+1 board/+1 KPI observed by t=26.44s; second focus after that new batch t=~28.44s → +0 LR in the next 2s.
request_timeline_evidence.RT-2_recovery_request: click at t=30.58s → LR request t=30.60s → LR 200 at t=31.73s (network latency 1.12s). Total UI recovery time (click→fd-tab-strip visible & fd-page-error gone): 3.56s.

action_items: MINOR: Deduplicate data-testid on Arrivals row-expansion drawer. When an expansion is rendered for reservation id 17, the drawer re-uses fd-row-17-checkin-btn and fd-row-17-kebab already present on the collapsed row. Either scope the drawer's testids (e.g., fd-row-17-expansion-checkin-btn, fd-row-17-expansion-kebab) or omit the duplicates entirely. This did not manifest in iteration_8's R12 duplicate-check because that run did not open an arrivals-row expansion during the check.
critical_code_review_comments: GuestTable/expansion drawer emits data-testid values identical to those on the parent row (fd-row-<id>-checkin-btn, fd-row-<id>-kebab). This is a testability bug — Playwright/CSS locators will match 2 nodes and either flake or over-count. Suffix the drawer's testids with '-expansion' or scope them to '[data-testid="fd-row-<id>-expansion"] [data-testid="..."]'.

Round-1 FAIL for BUG-435 Case C was correctly a measurement-window artifact (Round-1 measured the 5 s debounce from the click, not from the last snapshot response); with the corrected measurement (wait for the full batch to arrive, then 7 s idle, then focus), the focus refresh fires exactly +1 of each snapshot call and the immediate follow-up focus within 2 s is debounced. Code path in useFrontDeskSnapshot L52–54 is behaving as designed on preprod today; no code change indicated.

Round-1 FAIL for BUG-434 recovery matches the environmental hypothesis: on today's healthier preprod the recovery completed in 3.56 s (well under the 30 s budget) with exactly 1 LR request per click. Retain the existing recovery UX; the earlier 60 s stall was a preprod latency artifact, not a code regression.

success_rate.frontend: RT cases 4/4 (100%); REG-1 5/6 sub-checks pass (1 minor duplicate-testid finding)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sandbox 2026-09-21 evening still: Arrivals late=10 today=0 tomorrow=0 upcoming=4; Departures=2; In-house=2; Rooms all=5 (r1 HK, r2 occupied, r3 occupied, r4 HK, r5 HK), 0 free / 3 HK / 0 OOO / 20% occ. Preprod latency during Round 2 was healthy: login+first-snapshot ~15s; single LR round-trip ~1.1s; batch complete ~1.2s from click. Correct testids reminder: fd-tab-<id> tiles with fd-tab-<id>-count child; fd-chip-<tab>-<key>; in-house tab id is 'inhouse'. Duplicate-testid check MUST be repeated with a row expansion open on Arrivals — the collapsed-only check misses fd-row-<id>-checkin-btn/-kebab duplication. For BUG-435 Case C, measure the 5 s focus debounce from the LAST batch RESPONSE, never from a click.
rca of the issue: Round-1 FAIL (BUG-435 Case C): measurement error — the 6.5 s idle in Round 1 started at the click, but the batch itself took ~7 s to complete on Round-1's degraded preprod, so 'idle 6.5 s' finished BEFORE the batch responses had updated lastFetchRef; when focus fired, Date.now()-lastFetchRef was still <5000 ms and refresh was skipped. In Round 2, with the corrected rule (idle-from-last-response) and preprod at ~1.2 s batch latency, focus fires refresh exactly once. Round-1 FAIL (BUG-434 recovery): axios 60 s timeout on the recovery LR call because Round-1 preprod stalled that request; Round 2 preprod answered in 1.1 s and recovery completed in 3.56 s. No code change needed for these two. NEW MINOR finding: fd-row-<id>-checkin-btn and fd-row-<id>-kebab are emitted both by the collapsed row and by its expansion drawer, causing duplicate data-testid values whenever an arrivals row is expanded; the fix is to suffix the drawer's testids or scope them under the expansion container.
